'''Outer Rim Drifter's Armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[December 13]], [[2022]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett|''The Book of Boba Fett'']],<ref name="Reveal" /> being directly inspired by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] who served as an antagonist in the show,<ref name="TBOBF">''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''</ref> with the armor set even promoted on top of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] player model to better imitate Bane's appearance.<ref name="Reveal" />
